business_problem: WANdisco needed a way to help organizations overcome data-access and performance bottlenecks that slow AI and machine-learning development across distributed, hybrid environments.
solution_summary: WANdisco describes its work with watsonx.data as a way to solve a common bottleneck in enterprise AI and analytics: data is often trapped in on-premises, edge, and hybrid-cloud environments where accessibility and performance limit model development. In the reference architecture, watsonx.data acts as the IBM data layer that helps WANdisco connect clients to distributed data estates more quickly, so AI and machine learning teams can reach trusted information without first consolidating every source into a single legacy stack. WANdisco positions this alongside its own data-activation portfolio, which moves large IoT datasets and on-premises Hadoop data lakes to modern cloud platforms. The combined solution enables downstream AI, ML, and analytics use cases with broader, faster data access across hybrid environments, emphasizing timely access, hybrid connectivity, and cloud-era scale.
